provenance.inputs_summary: route_case for 5 ammonia scenarios x (Mode A + Mode B at 8 price levels)

model_versions.carbon_intensity: carbon.ts-equivalent simplified accounting, gate factors amcrax.environmental.lca.route_spec

provenance.hypothetical_warning: Every quantity under mode 'hypothetical_lca' is a HYPOTHETICAL life-cycle carbon price, not Singapore law.

mode_a_actual_boundary.label: Singapore carbon tax, actual boundary (Carbon Pricing Act 2018): direct reckonable facility emissions only, only at or above 25,000 tCO2e/yr
mode_a_actual_boundary.rate_source: Carbon Pricing Act 2018, Third Schedule Part 1 para 1(a)-(c) (statute text, SSO, accessed 2026-11-23)
mode_a_actual_boundary.threshold_source: Carbon Pricing Act 2018, Second Schedule Part 1 ('The second emissions threshold is 25,000 tCO2e.')

reference_plant_self_firing.label: Singapore carbon tax, actual boundary (Carbon Pricing Act 2018): direct reckonable facility emissions only, only at or above 25,000 tCO2e/yr

mode_a_actual_boundary.n2o_treatment: N2O is a covered gas (CPA First Schedule, GWP 265). No primary emission factor for the cracker burner exists in the AmCraX library, so N2O = 0 by default; the threshold test below gives the N2O rate needed to reach 25,000 tCO2e/yr.

n2o_threshold_test.basis: threshold 25,000 tCO2e/yr / GWP 265; fuel N = tail-gas NH3 (Aspen) + supplementary NH3 (economics); flue = stored FLUE + stoichiometric flue of the supplementary NH3 at the stored excess O2 (estimate)

mode_a_actual_boundary.n2o_at_ahmad_0p15_ppmv_note: 0.15 ppmv is a Chemkin result for an NH3 gas turbine (Ahmad 2025 p. 9), transferred to the cracker burner as an order-of-magnitude illustration only (low confidence).

natural_gas_heat_variant.note: Even when liable, the taxed CO2 is that of the gas burnt at the plant; it does not depend on the ammonia route.

mode_a_actual_boundary.consequence: Under the actual boundary the carbon cost is identical (zero) for grey, blue and green ammonia; low ammonia carbon intensity earns no cost advantage.

notes: Mode A LCOH equals the frozen singapore.evaluate default for every route (carbon tax 0).

Break-even NH3 price: price before carbon cost at which LCOH equals the benchmark (3.06 USD/kg NE Asia SMR incl. capex, Argus). Under Mode B it is given against the unadjusted benchmark and against the benchmark carrying its own hypothetical carbon cost (SMR unabated CI 11 kg/kg, IEA GHR 2024 10-12).
NPV at 3.06 USD/kg (and at the carbon-adjusted benchmark under Mode B), pre-tax, reference finance.
